description: Discover workspace-relative paths with doublestar glob semantics (*, ?, **). Hidden files are included by default; VCS internals are skipped. Results are sorted, capped, and returned with is_dir metadata.
name: glob

pattern.description: Doublestar glob pattern to match against paths under the search root, e.g. "*.go" or "**/*_test.go".

path.description: Workspace-relative directory to search. Omit or use "." for the workspace root.

limit.description: Maximum number of paths to return. Default 1000; hard cap 5000.
